title: 2012 Topps #47 Mark Barron Tampa Bay Buccaneers Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 2012 Topps sports trading card featuring Mark Barron, a rookie player for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in the National Football League (NFL). The card is part of the base set and is numbered 47. It is not autographed and was manufactured by Topps.
